{{Quote|Time to go to work. You won't let me get killed, will you?|Drey'lye to Jedi Knight Jaina Solo, shortly before meeting with Jagged Fel|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>}}
[[Tiurrg Drey'lye]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who served as the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]] in the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]] following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|And now, I believe, protocol insists that we open a bottle or a dozen of wine and make some preliminary discussion of security, introduction protocols, and so on.''"<br />"''Fortunately about the wine, and regrettably about everything else, you are correct.|[[Jagged Fel]] and Tiurrg Drey'lye|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Outcast" />}}
In the lead up to the [[Unification Summit]] between the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], [[Confederation]], and [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], Drey'lye was made the head of the [[Senate Unification Preparations Committee]]. In this capacity, Drey'lye, escorted by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], met with [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] in a perliminary meeting aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Gilad Pellaeon (starship)|''Gilad Pellaeon'']] before the official opening of the summit.
